reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the update to include Gemini thinking tokens in completion-token accounting. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Corrects completion-token accounting in the Python Google AI connector by including Gemini thinking tokens, so response usage and downstream telemetry reflect billed output tokens. The Vertex AI connector is unchanged. **Changes:** - Adds a shared helper that sums candidate and thinking tokens while handling missing counts. - Uses the helper in both chat and text completion response metadata. - Adds unit tests for token-count edge cases and both service integrations. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​test_google_ai_utils.py` | Tests the helper and chat/text usage accounting. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​utils.py` | Adds the completion-token counting helper. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​google_ai_text_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in text completion usage. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​google_ai/​services/​google_ai_chat_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in chat completion usage. |
Review effort: Balanced
